content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that reproduces Friedel-Crafts acylation retrosynthesis. The earlier search returned a template with ID 1914393 that seems to involve halide broken (Cl-CH2-aryl) and forming a bond to heterocycle? Actually the mapped_rxn shows Cl-CH2-aryl reacting with a heterocycle to give product with acyl? Wait product is the original molecule (complex). The template appears to be a C–C bond formation between CH2Cl and aromatic heterocycle? But Friedel-Crafts acylation involves acyl chloride (RCOCl) reacting with aromatic ring, breaking C-Cl bond and forming C-C(=O) bond. Our target molecule is COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1. It contains an amide C(=O)N attached to heterocycle. The retrosynthetic step likely breaks the amide bond? Actually Friedel-Crafts acylation would attach an acyl group onto aromatic ring. In our molecule, the aromatic ring (anisole) has a substituent CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3... )... So the acyl group is attached to heterocycle? The acyl chloride would be something like C(=O)Cl attached to aromatic? The template should break a carbonyl attached to aromatic? The search with functional_groups_broken halide gave template 1914393 which seems to involve Cl-CH2-aryl. That is not acyl chloride. Maybe need a template where halide broken and carbonyl formed (acyl chloride). The functional group formed could be "acyl chloride". But we tried that and got empty. Maybe need "alkyl halide" broken? Already halide includes both. The forward reaction: acyl chloride (R-CO-Cl) + aromatic -> acylated aromatic + HCl. So broken functional group: acyl chloride (the C-Cl bond). Formed: carbonyl attached to aromatic (ketone). In retrosynthesis, we break C-C bond between carbonyl carbon and aromatic carbon, forming acyl chloride as precursor. So functional_groups_broken: "aryl halide"? Actually the bond broken is C-Cl in acyl chloride, not in product. The product has carbonyl attached to aromatic (aryl ketone). So the template should break C-C bond and form acyl chloride? The search criteria allow specifying bonds broken/formed. Could specify bonds_broken: ["C-Cl"]? Format "6-6"? Not sure. Might search for templates where functional_groups_broken includes "acyl chloride". That is the precursor functional group broken in forward reaction (i.e., acyl chloride is broken). So we should search with functional_groups_broken ["acyl chloride"] and functional_groups_formed ["ketones"] maybe. Let's try.
